_comment: Shared golden fixture pinning the baseline-source rule to identical output across every reader of a student repo's history: Go contract.ResolveBaselineSource (cli/shared/contract/baseline.go; gh-student feedback_pr.go and gh-teacher feedbackpr/ensure.go apply the same rule through contract.IsShimBackfillCommit), TS baselineSource (web/src/github-core/queries/repoRefReads.ts), Python collect_scores.resolve_baseline_source and regrade_repos.is_shim_backfill_commit, and runner.py _baseline_scan (the git-backed reader, exercised on real repos built from these cases). Inputs: marker_message is the FULL commit message of the oldest commit touching .classroom50.yaml, or null when no commit does; root_is_baseline says whether the root commit is a valid fallback (true for every initialized repo, false only for a bare empty_repo or a built-in-autograder repo whose accept never finished). Rule: a marker whose subject (first line, trimmed) equals the enable-autograder backfill subject was added to a repo accepted without one, so the root is the baseline ('root'); any other marker is the accept commit ('marker'); no marker falls back to the root only when root_is_baseline ('root'), else there is no baseline ('none'). The subject comparison is exact after trimming: no case folding, no prefix matching, and the body (where [skip ci] lives) never participates.

cases.name: accept marker anchors regardless of shape flag
cases.marker_message: [Classroom 50] Initialize .classroom50.yaml and autograde workflow (gh student accept)

cases.name: accept marker still wins when the root would also be valid
legacy no_autograder accept (marker, no shim) anchors on the marker
student-authored marker with any other subject anchors on the marker
backfill-introduced marker keeps the root when the flag also says root
backfill subject with surrounding whitespace is trimmed
backfill subject with CRLF line ending is trimmed
case differs: not the backfill, so it is a marker
backfill subject as a prefix of a longer subject is not the backfill
cases.marker_message: [Classroom 50] Add autograde workflow (enable-autograder) and fix tests

cases.name: backfill subject only in the body is not the backfill
no marker on an initialized repo falls back to the root
no marker on a bare empty_repo has no baseline
